4704.title: Catalog resolution of slash-bearing Pi model IDs
4704.rootCauseOneLine: BB splits raw slash-bearing Pi IDs before catalog lookup, so strict startup verification compares Pi's actual model against a guessed provider/ID pair.
4704.proposedFix: Resolve exact canonical references first, then unique full raw IDs from the catalog; reject ambiguity or missing models and pass provider and raw ID explicitly to Pi.
4704.caveats: Repeated against the real bridge with synthetic RPC catalog data and checked against pinned Pi 0.84.0's actual offline resolver; no live desktop or account reproduction. Reproduction code is inline in the HTML.
